answer.why: It sounds like a game about climbing to the top and getting rich, which is exactly the sort of ambitious, slightly cheeky life I like to play. It's easy to understand at a glance and I'd tap it just to see how much a minister earns and whether I can get there.
answer.expect_minister_salary: A funny, cheeky ladder-climbing game where I work my way up to being a minister and watch my pay packet grow, with scandals and temptations along the way. I'd expect money and power to be the main hook, maybe some corruption or drama.
answer.expect_confirmed_substantive: No idea, honestly. It sounds like dry legal or HR jargon, maybe a boring office or paperwork sim about getting a job made permanent. I wouldn't know it was a game about a career in government, and it doesn't promise any drama, so I'd scroll right past.
